source: Pew Research Center. 2015. "2014 Religious Landscape Study."
method: Population is current religious tradition (RELTRAD), restricted to Christian traditions - qh2 was asked only of respondents the survey's skip logic had already classified as Christian; non-Christian and unaffiliated respondents have no valid cases on this item. Share shown is those who say some non-Christian religions can also lead to eternal life, vs. only Christian religions; don't know/refused/undesignated are excluded from each row's denominator. Groups with fewer than 30 valid respondents are omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own national WEIGHT variable.
